observations.why: Quinton asserts cadence by positional authority (legitimate) and backs it with a logical equivalence framing rehearsal as prerequisite for capability (rational-persuasion).
Metadata record supplying the decided cadence as fact; informational control of the record, no influence attempt on an audience.
